author: Times News
description:
“If the regime doesn’t have to pay for reconstructing whatever it is we’re going to reconstruct, they’re going to use it to embed themselves.”

The proposed $300bn reconstruction of Iran included in the US-Iran peace deal is “going to basically permanently put in place this regime”, says former US assistant secretary of defence for Middle East under Trump Mick Mulroy.

Mick Mulroy was speaking to Ayesha Hazarika on Times Radio Drive.  Listen live everyday from 4-7pm.

description:
“We’ve got another crisis now, because of course, we have wasted a decade, we've had now maybe our seventh Prime Minister next week.  And at the end of the day, we do not have a clear plan.” 

Lord Rose is “not hopeful” under this government that the UK will be able to reboot their EU relations with “lunatics like Miliband”. 

Stuart Rose was speaking to Adam Boulton on Times Radio.  Listen live every Sunday, 10am-1pm.

Ross Harrison and Lieutenant Colonel Daniel L. Davis were speaking to Darryl Morris on Times Radio.  Listen live everyday, 10pm-1am.
